# Synthetic Preflight packages

These fixtures are entirely synthetic and contain no real addresses, people, lender data, or appraisal conclusions. They exist only to exercise package classification and intake findings.

- `01_complete_package.zip`: XML, PDF stub, and photos.
- `02_missing_pdf.zip`: XML and photos, no PDF.
- `03_missing_photos.zip`: XML and PDF stub, no photos.
- `04_unreadable_xml.zip`: unreadable XML content, PDF stub, and photo.

The PDF and JPEG files are lightweight fixture stubs for upload/classification tests, not production appraisal documents.
